lead: Bob Dylan is an American songwriter, born on 24 May 1941 in Duluth.
As of 2026, he is 85 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He is associated with work such as Like a Rolling Stone, Highway 61 Revisited and Bringing It All Back Home and has been recognised with National Medal of Arts and Presidential Medal of Freedom.
The sections that follow break down Bob Dylan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Bob Dylan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bob Dylan was born on 24 May 1941 in Duluth, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Robert Allen Zimmerman at birth and is publicly known as Bob Dylan.
Public records name his father, Abram Zimmerman and his mother, Beatrice Stone.
He studied at University of Minnesota System, Hibbing High School and Sidwell Friends School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Bob Dylan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists songwriter, film actor, poet, guitarist, autobiographer and painter as his occupations.

Among the credits most often linked to Bob are Like a Rolling Stone, Highway 61 Revisited, Bringing It All Back Home, Blonde on Blonde, Blood on the Tracks, Blowin' in the Wind and Subterranean Homesick Blues.
He performs on guitar, harmonica, piano and voice.
He has taken part in Mariposa Folk Festival 1973 and Live Aid.

sections.heading: Bob Dylan — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Sara Dylan (married 1965, until 1977) and Carolyn Dennis (married 1986, until 1992).
He is a parent to Jesse Dylan and Jakob Dylan.

sections.heading: Bob Dylan — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Bob Dylan circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a songwriter, film actor, poet, guitarist, autobiographer and painter, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and project fees and royalties from credited work.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
